# spydersoftidentity_api_resource (Data Source)

Looks up an API resource by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "spydersoftidentity_api_resource" "example" {
  name = "example-api"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique API resource name.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description.
- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the API resource is enabled.
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier assigned by the server.
- `properties` (Map of String) Custom key/value properties.
- `scopes` (Set of String) Names of the scopes this API resource supports.
- `user_claims` (Set of String) User claim types included in access tokens for this resource.
